template_status: New blank reusable Change Log templates derived from the six required fields in the supplied judging guideline. Seven optional prompts are explicitly labelled. No participant records or results are included.
source_notes: The supplied CN/EN judging guidelines materially agree.
The earlier at-least-three peer-challenge requirement is from the separate organizer account, not from these four files.
News motivation paragraphs are source translations without new citations or independent historical validation. Scenario backgrounds and cards remain hypothetical.
ClinicNow source refers both to WHO emergency listing and prequalification; neither is silently substituted for the other.
Mossback source gives a cost per tonne without further specifying the denominator; translation does not add one.
The scenario source title says Project Track; the English title preserves that wording. The Wiki describes the actual content as eight fictional briefs without silently relabelling the source.
publication: Official PDF URLs received from user on 2026-10-21 and applied to both Inclusivity and Contribution. Editable Markdown and CSV sources retain their repository download links.
